user_look: A tar and gravel roof with patched seams and galvanised vents, edged by a concrete parapet with rust streaks, with the far rooftops across the top of the frame. At frame right stand a scuffed metal table with a small speaker and paper cups and a plain wooden bench. The three friends dance in a loose row, evenly spaced with clear floor between them, each with both arms raised, loose and joyful. Low golden-hour sun from frame right rakes across the roof, throws long shadows of all three toward frame left and warms their faces. Golden low sun, warm tar and gravel, bright fabric.
